hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points negative one, negative three and three, four. There is a horizontal dotted segment from negative one, negative three to three, negative three that is labeled four. There is a vertical dotted segment from three, negative three to three, four that is labeled seven.

hints.content:
Going from the point on the left to the point on the right, the change in $y$ is $\purpleD 7$, and the change in $x$ is $\redD 4$.

$\text{Slope}=\dfrac{\purpleD{\text{rise}}}{\redD{\text{run}}}=\dfrac{\purpleD{\Delta y}}{\redD{\Delta x}}=\dfrac{\purpleD{7}}{\redD{4}}$
The slope of the line is $\dfrac{7}{4}$.
